{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for any non-numeric strings beyond the expected format
print(df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.isnumeric().all())

# Now safely convert revenue to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm conversion
print(df['revenue'].dtype)
print(df['revenue'].head())"}
